introHtml: Kraft lip balm offers a natural, eco-friendly look that stands out on a desk or in a gift bag. The unbleached paper tube pairs well with organic ingredients and subtle branding. Perfect for trade shows, corporate gifts, or retail displays, these balms can be foil-stamped or printed with your logo for a rustic yet professional appearance.
